title: Seat and lock the DGX H100/H200 PSU-end power cord
instruction: On the de-energized DGX power-supply fixture, seat the loose system-end cord with its gray ring unlocked, then turn the ring to locked. Release both hands.
context: NVIDIA documents seating the system-end cable unlocked and then turning the independent ring to lock during PSU service.
setup: Use a de-energized face-up PSU bench fixture with one C19/C20 mating position and two adjacent plugs. The target face is (300, 10, 36) mm from the table origin. The loose cord starts nose-down in a fixed open cradle, with seat datum (222, -168, 23.3) mm and gray collar unlocked.
scoring: 0.25 for keyed entry. 0.60 for seating after unlocked entry. 1.0 after seating and lock with both hands clear and the plug still for one second. Force-through, a locked entry, or extracting a confirmed lock returns zero.
reset_notes: Restore the cord with its nose in the open cradle, reset the ring to unlocked, keep the fixture and neighboring plugs fixed and clear the trial state.
fidelity: The C19-style mating face is 28 × 20 mm based on a published commercial C19 drawing. NVIDIA's images ground the tapered backshell, gray collar and three-port bench slice. Model-specific dimensions, contact and retention geometry, collar travel and torque, the face-up bench pose and the short cable are approximations pending a check against a DGX OEM cord and inlet.
